Their livelihoods had become more precarious despite accepting displacement as a sacrifice for national development

questions.subtopic: Case Study 2: Traditional Rainwater Harvesting in Rajasthan
questions.question:
Case Study 2 (Q14–Q16): In the arid regions of Rajasthan, many traditional houses had an underground tanka.

Q14: Where were these tankas commonly located, and how were they connected to the rooftop?
options: Dug on top of the roof
Built inside the courtyard or house, connected to the sloping rooftop via PVC or clay pipes
Placed on public roads outside the city walls
Floated inside village ponds
questions.explanation: NCERT describes tankas as underground tanks built inside the main house or courtyard and connected to sloping roofs by pipes. The previous stem's claim that every traditional house had a tanka was too absolute.

questions.subtopic: Case Study 4: The Bamboo Drip System of Meghalaya
questions.question:
Case Study 4 (Q19–Q20): In Meghalaya, a traditional system of tapping stream and spring water using bamboo pipes is widely used.

Q20: For which plantation crops is this bamboo-drip irrigation system commonly used?
options: Black pepper and betel vine (Piper betle), often grown in arecanut orchards
Wheat and mustard
Sugarcane and cotton
Rubber and coffee
questions.explanation: Government of Meghalaya material identifies betel vine (Piper betle) and black pepper (Piper nigrum) as crops irrigated using bamboo-drip channels, often in arecanut orchards. Arecanut (Areca catechu) is a separate plant and should not be used as a synonym for betel vine.

questions.subtopic: Case Study 4: The Bamboo Drip System of Meghalaya
questions.question: Case Study 4 (Continued): Which engineering feature allows the bamboo-drip system to convey water without powered pumps or metal pipe networks?
options: It is operated by solar-powered computerized motors
It uses copper pipes imported from England
Bamboo poles of different diameters are slit and fitted together using wooden pegs and natural gravity, without requiring pumps, electricity, or metals
It relies on diesel generators placed at each plant
questions.explanation: Locally available bamboo culms of different sizes are joined into gravity-fed channels and outlets. The system does not need powered pumps or metal pipe networks, but it is not maintenance-free: Government of Meghalaya material notes periodic cleaning and reinforcement after seasonal monsoons.
